description: Verdict on whether an Owletto diff range has any user-visible UI surface, for the ui-review gate's agent-judged not-applicable path.

has_ui_surface.description: True if the range touches ANYTHING a human could see rendered: templates, HTML/CSS, images/icons, extension popup/sidepanel/UI components, SwiftUI/AppKit views, user-visible copy shown in a rendered surface (not just an internal log or error message), layout, or asset files. When genuinely unsure or the range is large/mixed, answer true — this gate fails closed.

reasoning.description: Concrete justification citing the actual changed files and why they do or do not have UI surface. Must name specific files, not a general claim.

verification_summary.description: How the change was otherwise verified (tests run, pass/fail counts, manual reproduction) — cite specifics from the diff/PR content, not a restatement of the reasoning.
